subject: general
question: A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits fourth to the right of F. Only two people sit between A and Q. Only two people sit between R and Q. P sits to the immediate left of B. How many people sit between P and E when counted from the right of E?
solution: Given: A, B, E, F, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) A sits fourth to the right of F. 2) Only two people sit between A and Q. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f17338faa7d69d3f65cc2293fdefce30720a74c7d6eb8844c14c593abb4ad70.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef2722cd3f079042ea3101420d8df9e8b80f999e749b44c34186ffe6d6855921.png] 3) Only two people sit between R and Q.
